issue_context.title: Cannot retrieve parameters from DH key created using d2i_AutoPrivateKey_ex()
issue_context.body:
I've found that if I use the d2i_AutoPrivateKey_ex API then I can create a valid EVP_PKEY but the EVP_PKEY_get_bn_param() calls to retrieve the P & G values fail.

Here's a modified test to show the failure:

https://github.com/openssl/openssl/commit/2b76d9b1d031597f5e8c64c157bb31e4618b106e

The EVP_PKEY_get0_DH() and DH_get0_pqg() APIs return the parameters fine but the test fails on the first call to EVP_PKEY_get_bn_param().
comments:
There are two issues here:

1) Why does d2i_AutoPrivateKey_ex result in an EVP_PKEY with a legacy key?
and
2) When you have a legacy key why doesn't EVP_PKEY_get_bn_param() work?

For the second issue I have raised #13528

review_comments: Do I need to pull the private key out here to check that it worked? The selection is basically 'all' so maybe this could just return a public key?

You could use `evp_keymgmt_has` with the selection `OSSL_KEYMGMT_SELECT_PRIVATE_KEY` to check...  and yes, I believe that would be a good idea.  But in that case, don't pass `pp` directly to `OSSL_DECODER_from_data()`
